claims: Artemis I was an uncrewed test flight of the Space Launch System (SLS) rocket and Orion capsule.
Artemis I orbited the Moon to verify systems.
Artemis II is the first crewed flight of the Artemis program.
Reid Wiseman, Victor Glover, Christina Koch, and Jeremy Hansen are crew members of Artemis II.
Artemis II is a 10-day crewed flyby around the Moon.
Artemis II crew will fly around the Moon and return.
Artemis II will test systems for future landings.
Artemis III/IV are targeted to be the first crewed landing on the lunar South Pole.
Artemis III will test essential docking technologies in orbit before the landing.
Artemis III/IV plan to land astronauts including the first woman and person of color near the lunar South Pole.
Space Launch System (SLS) is NASA's heavy-lift rocket.
Space Launch System (SLS) is designed to send the Orion capsule to the Moon.
Orion Spacecraft is the crew capsule designed for long-duration deep space missions.
SpaceX Starship and Blue Origin are commercial partners developing the Human Landing Systems (HLS) for the Moon's surface.
